# Rakitsu tested build: v0.3.2 (09c37a8e)
name: "Invoice exception review"
version: "1.0"
description: "Compare an invoice to the purchase order and receiving note, then draft a hold reason."
settings:
  default_provider: ollama
  providers:
    ollama:
      type: ollama
      base_url: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1
      default_model: qwen3:4b-q4_K_M
  defaults:
    temperature: 0
    max_tokens: 1400
agents:
  - name: Analyst
    role: worker
    system_prompt: "Use the supplied fixture. Distinguish facts from assumptions."
    settings: { max_iterations: 1 }
  - name: Reviewer
    role: worker
    system_prompt: "Check the analysis against the fixture. Return only the requested deliverable."
    settings: { max_iterations: 1 }
orchestrator:
  name: Recipe
  strategy: Pipeline
  agents: [Analyst, Reviewer]
  pipeline:
    steps:
      - name: analyze
        agent: Analyst
        task: "Extract invoice, PO and receiving facts. Identify unit price and quantity differences. /no_think"
      - name: review
        agent: Reviewer
        task: "Write an approval recommendation and two discrepancy bullets. Include INV-81, HOLD, USD 18 vs USD 16, and 46 received with 4 missing. /no_think"
